round.title: Yellow Propoganda
round.content: The piece should feel visually strong, memorable, and message-driven. Submissions can reference Yellow Collective, Base, Nouns, Farcaster, public goods, artistic process, creative independence, or the broader idea of building culture onchain.
round.description: Create a bold piece of propaganda that promotes onchain art, supporting artists, creative freedom, public goods, or community-owned culture.

submissions.title: Yellow🟡 The Culture We Own
submissions.description: Yellow is a movement for artists to create freely, support each other, and build culture together. Onchain, creators can take ownership of their work and communities can shape the culture they believe in. Made by us, owned by us, built for everyone.

submissions.title: TOO MUCH SLOP
submissions.description:
Too much slop
make art great again

submissions.title: On-chain Art for All
submissions.description: On-chain Art for All—An Opportunity to Create! A school for children with disabilities serves as a space where every child—whether they are deaf, physically disabled, have Down syndrome, an intellectual disability, or are blind—can learn, express themselves, and develop their talents without limits. Support creative freedom, value every child’s work, and build an inclusive future through on-chain art. Because every child possesses potential, every creation holds value, and everyone deserves an equal opportunity to create.

submissions.title: Draw or Die! 🫀 by msmeghna
submissions.description:
Creating art isn't merely a hobby, it's something an artist needs to feel alive. 
We don't create just to make art, we create because some things inside us can only breathe through it! 🫀🎨
~Done using mixed media on paper.

submissions.title: Less Talk. Make More
submissions.description: Less talk. More art. More freedom. More culture onchain.

submissions.title: Creative Freedom 🪽
submissions.description:
Creativity was never meant to be caged.
The bird is a folded origami piece and the B&W part of her body inside the frame represents creative restrictions. As she escapes the frame by breaking the thread/chain she was tied to, the part of her body outside the frame is shown colourful and represents creative freedom 🌈🫟
I made this craft piece with cardboard, paper, matchstick, thread and colour pens.

submissions.title: 💛Paint the world Yellow💛
submissions.description:
Hello, im Valentina, and this is my entry for the Yellow Round💛
Whether you're an artist, a dreamer, or simply someone who loves to create,  there's always room for another splash of yellow.
Paint the World Yellow 🎨💛

submissions.title: Road to Yellow
submissions.description:
Iva and Distubio, founders of the Nounish Art School in Peru, travel in a classic taxi to share art and onboard people to Yellow. Their goal is to bring free art and new opportunities to emerging artists outside the city.
Colaborative art by Disturbio @ledisturbio and @ivannalen

submissions.title: YELLOW IS EVERYWHERE
submissions.description:
We brought onchain art into the real world by placing Yellow Collective brand logo stickers around the city. More than just a visual presence, "Yellow Is Everywhere" is an initiative to spark curiosity, catch people's attention, and introduce them to the world of onchain art in unexpected places.

Yellow Collective is more than a logo. It's a presence, a movement, and a reminder that onchain culture can exist everywhere.
